meta.name: qa-commit
meta.description: Verify implementation against QA Contract (G#N, AC#N), auto-invoke debug on RED

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动验证代码是否符合验收条件，失败时启动调试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在提交前自动检查代码是否满足QA合约
copy.tagline_en: Auto-verify code against QA contracts, trigger debug on failure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically check code against QA contracts before commit

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在提交前检查代码是否满足指定的测试场景和验收标准。如果全部通过，返回 GREEN；如果有失败项，返回 RED 并自动启动调试流程来修复。
howto.when: 在 PR 审查通过后、提交代码前自动触发，或在提交工作流中自动运行。也可手动说“use qa-commit skill”来执行。

say.text: 验证当前提交是否满足 G#1 和 AC#3
say.note: Claude 将检查这两个标准并报告结果。

say.text: 检查此提交的 QA 合同
say.note: 执行所有验证阶段并给出最终裁定。
触发完整验证流程，包含技术检查和测试。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will verify the current commit against assigned QA contract criteria (Gherkin scenarios and acceptance criteria). Returns GREEN (pass) or RED (fail) and auto-invokes debug on failure.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically after PR review passes, before git commit, or during Agent Mode commit workflow. Can also be invoked manually by saying 'use qa-commit skill'.

say_en.text: Verify current commit satisfies G#1 and AC#3
say_en.note: Claude will check these criteria and report.

say_en.text: Check QA contract for this commit
say_en.note: Runs all verification phases and gives verdict.
Triggers full verification including tech checks and tests.
